title: Rate Computation Note: Contract Rate Set on an Equipment & Vehicle Loans Autopay Enrolment
content:
**Computation.** On enrolment the contract rate on record of an Equipment & Vehicle Loans loan is reduced by the product's autopay rate discount, except that the reduction may not exceed the product's rate discount cap less the relationship discount the loan received at funding; the loan received that discount when the member's operating line, the first one the operating-line lookup lists where there are several, was booked on or before the loan's funding date and had not been closed by that date, and the discount so received stays fixed at funding and counts against the cap whatever the line's status has become since; the reduced rate is rounded to 3 decimal places and may not be lower than the product's rate floor.

## The quantities, defined

| Quantity | Source |
|---|---|
| Contract rate on record | the loan's contract rate on the enrolment date |
| Autopay rate discount, rate discount cap, relationship discount, rate floor | the product's figures in its schedule of rates |
| Relationship discount received at funding | the product's relationship discount when the member's Operating Lines of Credit line (the first the operating-line lookup lists, where there are several) shows a booking date on or before the loan's funding date and no closing date on or before it; otherwise none |
| Room under the cap | the rate discount cap less the relationship discount received at funding |
| Rate set | the contract rate on record less the smaller of the autopay rate discount and the room under the cap, rounded to 3 decimal places, and not below the rate floor |

## Whether the relationship discount was received at funding

| The listed operating line's booking date | Its closing date | Relationship discount received at funding |
|---|---|---|
| on or before the loan's funding date | none, or after the funding date | yes |
| on or before the loan's funding date | on or before the funding date | no |
| after the funding date | any | no |
| the member holds no operating line | — | no |

A discount received at funding still counts against the cap when the line has since closed or been suspended.

## Worked examples (hypothetical inputs, Used Equipment Loan: autopay 0.25, relationship 0.15, cap 0.35, floor 5.5)

- **Discount received at funding.** Contract rate on record 7.300. Room under the cap: 0.35 less 0.15, that is 0.20. The reduction is the smaller of 0.25 and 0.20, that is 0.20; the rate set is 7.100.
- **No discount received at funding.** Contract rate on record 7.300. Room under the cap: 0.35. The reduction is 0.25; the rate set is 7.050.
- **The floor.** Contract rate on record 5.600 with no discount received at funding: 5.600 less 0.25 is 5.350, below the floor of 5.5; the rate set is 5.500.
